items.title: Compile the pinned SKOS release into the BAMF semantic authority snapshot
items.api: compile_atlas_release(corpus_dir, coverage_receipt, prior_abi, formal_domain_bindings) -> AtlasRelease; validate_atlas_release(release) -> ReleaseValidation
items.steps: Read the canonical release produced by #291 and verify its source, coverage and RDF digests. Emit stable concept records, admitted types/relations, morphology/sense distinctions, source loci, held mappings and canonical ordering. Preserve root versus Stem x Specification sense identities; emit allomorph/form variants as realizations, not duplicate meanings. Retain the existing formal Boolean/numeric source owners with explicit domain bindings. Derive ABI entries in the prior accepted ordering followed by canonical new-ID ordering. Persist atlas.json, concepts.jsonl, relations.jsonl, held.jsonl and a content-addressed manifest using the repository canonical serializer. Count source rows, RDF terms, semantic concepts, active ABI indices and trainable capabilities separately. Attach an explicit reason to every corpus item that is not yet a teaching candidate. Complete #292's projection contract through this leaf rather than implementing a second registry. The graph materialization receipt may witness the same digest, but canonical RDF/IR bytes supply the build. Expose a pure read API so neural workers consume a frozen snapshot without a database. Predecessor trace: BAV-REQ-001/002; the implementation follows the explicit BAMF-0.2 contract repeated here.
items.tests: Two clean builds from the same pinned release have identical digests. A literal root with two source-attested senses stays two senses. A held mapping stays held and absent from active indices. Reordering input files does not renumber prior indices. A stale coverage receipt yields an explicit source-owned error before output promotion. Record the real corpus census and one formal-domain binding; do not substitute an empty toy atlas for the corpus build.

items.title: Implement append-only semantic banks and active-vocabulary allocation
items.api: plan_vocabulary_extension(prior, admissions, shape_policy) -> VocabularyExtension; apply_vocabulary_extension(parent, plan) -> CandidateState
items.steps: Represent global ABI indices as bank*8192+offset and keep a stable full-ID map. Start one bank; append another only when qualified admissions exceed existing capacity. Activation within a reserved bank initializes the row from its source features and creates zero moments/count0; inactive rows are not trained through tied softmax. Expansion binds previous generation, allocation-source digest and admitted IDs. Prepare tensors, active mask, output-domain map and registry-mirror delta together, then pass them to the existing admission transaction. Preserve all old row bytes and optimizer state. When count exceeds65535, uint32 extended indices continue without an address-codec redesign; validate uint32 bounds. Full output logits are the ordered concatenation of active bank projections, never a modulo alias. Mirror admitted token descriptions and allocation lineage into the existing Registry evidence/export contract; a spreadsheet remains a navigable mirror, not an independent semantic registry. Provide a resource estimate before materializing new banks and stage until it fits. Predecessor trace: BAV-REQ-011; the implementation follows the explicit BAMF-0.2 contract repeated here.
items.tests: Exercise indices8191,8192 and16384. Existing rows/moments hash identically before and after accepted extension; inactive logits cannot win. Simulate rejection and crash before pointer publication and recover the exact old bank extent. A stable meaning receives the same index under source reordering; duplicate/mismatched meaning blocks only the new admission. Verify the tied readout and registry mirror have the same active set.

items.title: Bind typed AST semantics to role-addressable frame contracts
items.api: FrameSchema; RoleSpec; ConceptRef; FrameInstance; bind_ast_frames(ast, AtlasRelease) -> FrameTree
items.steps: Define frozen typed records with schema versions and canonical serialization. Reuse existing AST constructors and approved operator meanings. Introduce FrameInstance occurrence IDs derived from source-instance identity plus structural path, separate from canonical content digest. Use (role_id,occurrence_index) keys and explicit parent/child edges. Specify NONE, UNKNOWN and unresolved alternative bindings through declared typed states, not absent dictionary keys. Validate role counts, allowed types, scope and declared causal prefix. Preserve atomic fallback for AST constructs lacking an approved frame schema. Create released adapters for current A/B/C source ASTs without branching the trainer by grade. Bind each new schema to actual source rules; an executable formal operator may have a formal-domain schema when a New Ithkuil realization is not yet admitted. Return typed errors through the existing error catalog with source span and failed role. Predecessor trace: BAV-REQ-003/006; the implementation follows the explicit BAMF-0.2 contract repeated here.
items.tests: Literal TRANSFER fixtures swap agent/recipient and yield different bindings/content IDs. Repeated same-type members in distinct roles survive. Singular-role duplication fails; explicitly plural role with occurrence0/1 succeeds. Nested negation/scope round-trips without flattening. Unknown schema takes the atomic fallback with all source data preserved. A foreign semantic-release ID fails before neural use.

items.title: Build the reversible four-slot frame codec and extended fallback
items.api: pack4(indices, schema_tag) -> uint64; unpack4(word, schema_map) -> SlotTuple; pack_frame(frame) -> PackedFrame
items.steps: Implement exact shifts/masks from the frame contract using integer operations. Validate ranges before packing, reserve version1 and record complete presence1111. Keep schema tag lookup release-local and content-addressed. Serialize the u64 in little-endian8 bytes with an explicit codec identifier; JSON may expose its decimal string to avoid floating-point loss. Encode all other frames in extended canonical slot arrays with uint32 indices, child references and occurrence metadata. Select fallback by a typed disposition, never by catching arbitrary exceptions. Use the same exact role-index accessor for both representations so downstream neural code is codec-neutral. Include original constituent order and full source metadata in the sidecar. Empty/zero indices are distinct. This is a compact representation, not a separate semantic identity. Predecessor trace: BAV-REQ-004; the implementation follows the explicit BAMF-0.2 contract repeated here.
items.tests: Round-trip[0,1,8190,8191], all-zero and all-max words against literal expected integers. Version mismatch and illegal presence mask reject.17th schema, index8192, five-slot frame and nested frame all choose extended encoding and reconstruct exactly. Two frame occurrences with identical contents share content identity but retain distinct occurrence IDs.

items.title: Compile causally valid mixed frame and atomic sequences
items.api: compile_prefix(ast, visible_end, release, compiler_config) -> CompiledFrameBatch; reconstruct(compiled) -> VisibleAST
items.steps: Implement a streaming partial-frame builder. Close and pack a frame only when its final required constituent is visible. Represent incomplete frames by the visible atoms or explicit partial node; never rewrite an already-consumed prefix position in an incremental cache. For append streaming, emit a closure reference at the closing position; full-prefix compilation may compact the complete frame only in a newly keyed cache epoch. Emit position-to-source maps, source-to-position maps, prefix ends, scope boundaries, padding mask, exact role access and expansion handles. Include policy version in compiler digest. Keep batch rows independent. Compile answers only as target tensors outside the model input view. Bound neural length to1024 and report overflow before padding/allocation; split lawful source sequences at existing boundaries rather than silently truncate. Return actual atoms/frame, fallback shares and sidecar bytes. Predecessor trace: BAV-REQ-005; the implementation follows the explicit BAMF-0.2 contract repeated here.
items.tests: Compile every prefix of a literal four-member frame and show unavailable members never appear in embeddings or handles. Compare logits for identical prefixes with different future suffixes using B11 integration. Mixed atomic/nested/packed sequences reconstruct the same visible AST. Streamed closure changes cache identity rather than mutating old keys. A two-row batch with unequal lengths has no cross-row content or padding visibility.

items.title: Compile source-grounded factorized features once per release
items.steps: Implement AtlasFeatures/v2 exactly as specified in the shared Feature schema. Materialize maps, graph vectors, exact ID sidecars and predecessor binding for the full admitted corpus. Reuse canonical SKOS relation predicates without deriving curriculum prerequisites from taxonomy. Export the immutable feature manifest consumed by A02 initialization and B02 embeddings. Keep inference/training reads local and preserve held-source reasons. Tests below enforce successor identity stability. Use literal committed fixture vectors computed by a small independent reference script using the stated SHA256 byte rules.
items.tests: Two builds have identical features. Swapping a role changes its feature while leaving concept identity unchanged. Held relations do not enter admitted feature inputs. A disconnected concept receives explicit zero neighborhood plus its own type features. No runtime function in the gradient path opens a network connection. The feature manifest survives source-file reordering. Insert a lexically earlier new category into a successor release; every old learned row retains the same ID. Test two categories beyond512, exact zero graph, signed collision accumulation and independent golden-vector agreement.

items.title: Register exact semantic and deterministic cognitive operators
items.api: CognitiveOperatorSpec; OperatorRegistry; execute_pure(operator_id, typed_inputs, binding) -> TypedValue
items.steps: Register role lookup, identity/type inspection, set membership, Boolean functions, bounded integer operations, exact rational duration/unit conversion and released structural relations. Each operator declares input/output signatures, applicability conditions, implementation digest and pure-effect contract. Operands come only from task-visible input and admitted knowledge. Independent evaluation owns target gold. Reuse independently verified source algorithms where runtime use is allowed but keep evaluator entrypoints unreachable from solver dependencies. Return UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED for an inapplicable operator rather than coercing null or interpreting a plan as an occurrence. Record operation count and source binding, not verbose internal prose. Known results may be memoized by complete input and operator identity. Make function composition and partial application ordinary typed DAG nodes.
items.tests: Literal2+3=5, Boolean truth cases,0.25h=15min and role lookup work with no neural call. Null differs from0. Planned event cannot satisfy occurred-event predicate. Cached operation with changed release or operator version misses. A repository dependency test prevents solver imports of assessment/gold-label APIs. End-to-end scoring C05 gives full capability credit to this path.

items.title: Generate capability and lesson programs across the full SKOS inventory
items.steps: Build reusable family adapters for positive identity, typed role binding, source-attested relation recognition, morphology composition/decomposition, numeric/Boolean composition, scope/modality/time distinctions and released transformations. Enumerate every semantic concept in the pinned atlas and map it to required source-qualified construction families or a source-qualification hold; missing implementation remains IMPLEMENTATION_UNCOVERED debt. For each family emit positive constructive teaching, source-valid contrasts, canonical answer modality, independent checker reference, prerequisite closure and variation axes. Definitions and source examples supply input facts; do not invent causal laws from English glosses. Qualified source facts can be looked up directly; harder tasks combine/rebind them. Store capability ID as a digest-stable semantic/operator signature, not root ordinal or grade letter. Use existing FactoryRelease/ExecutableFactoryRelease and factory verifier.1-9 capability deltas are data. Additional root breadth reuses the same engine rather than creating one issue or trainer per root.
items.tests: Build the actual full-atlas coverage ledger, with eligible/held counts reconciling to source concept census. Demonstrate current numeric/Boolean family plus one real source-attested morphology/role family. New concept within a supported family changes data only. Missing constructor/checker is IMPLEMENTATION_UNCOVERED with exact owner/reason while unrelated ready families still compile. Teaching construction explicitly contains its declared constituents before composite tests.

items.title: Generate a resumable prerequisite-aware curriculum frontier
items.steps: Project A08 candidates into the existing CandidateFrontierRelease and CandidateBinding shapes. Resolve prerequisite closure using taught/current capability evidence. Rank eligible deltas first by smallest prerequisite slope, then released downstream unlock count, then oldest unvisited ready item and stable ID. Expose salience features to the existing teacher; priority never alters semantic gold. Resume from content-addressed coverage ledger and cursor; no root can vanish merely because a newer release arrived. Batch up to16 new IDs and1-9 capabilities; recursively schedule constituent introductions before composites. Emit COMPLETE_ATLAS_COVERAGE only when every frozen source-eligible concept has its requested task coverage and implementation-uncovered debt is zero; HELD entries remain enumerated with source/remediation owners. Propose and stage successors continuously. Runtime adoption remains C07's explicit lease/admission boundary.
items.tests: Three successive generated deltas advance beyond A/B/C without grade-specific code. Restart after staged delta produces the same next candidate. A blocked prerequisite holds its dependents while unrelated ready work progresses. Corpus reordering changes neither capability IDs nor prior allocation. A release containing only held items returns actionable coverage status, not false graduation or an infinite empty loop.

items.title: Compile BRAVO evidence strata into Factory learning releases
items.steps: Consume source-span-linked interpreted frames from the qualified VieDay stratum release. Begin with category/value/unit summaries, then time logs, structured reflections and narrative subsets as each is available. Use PUBLIC_FIXTURE analogues for public tests; PRIVATE_REAL intake uses #327's private boundary. Bind source digest, interpretation revision, concept/role IDs, prerequisite capabilities, positive/negative families, checker, task modality and rights to each lesson. Preserve blank/zero, reported/computed values, planned/occurred status, negation, temporal disagreements and alternate interpretations. Train typed reconstruction and a small declared English template codec initially; free-form narrative stays separate until its qualified semantics exist. Split by source episode/template lineage for fresh challenges, while ordinary post-exam errors remain teachable under the existing classroom policy. No all-strata gate: one qualified subset can feed an ordinary FactoryRelease. Commit the PUBLIC_FIXTURE source, parsed record, expected Frame/lesson and exact checker result from Bravo fixture.
items.tests: One public structured summary becomes a source-linked typed lesson and independent exact check.0.25h/15min match; blank differs from0; planned differs fromcompleted; contradictory dates remain alternatives. Unclassified/private source is rejected by public export. One held narrative span does not block qualified structured summaries. A source interpretation correction changes only dependent lesson families. T1 emits completed and15-minute derived answer; T2 retains PLANNED and cannot satisfy an occurred predicate; T3 has UNKNOWN, not0. A missing qualified private stratum changes only its held count. Existing public snapshots continue through the same Factory.

items.title: Generate lawful ambiguity and structural contrast lessons
items.steps: Implement typed transformations: role swap, cardinality change, scope/negation movement, known/unknown substitution, planned/occurred contrast, missing-versus-negative observation, and source-authorized morphology alternatives. Each transformation declares applicability and checker-derived outcome. Maintain original source and generated variant lineage separately. Add bounded ambiguity exploration with at most4 source-compatible interpretations per example, ranked deterministically; preserve unresolved alternatives as the target when evidence cannot choose. Controlled noise operates on presentation or available cues, not canonical identities/gold. Save the noise signature(type,location,amount,seed) so a later lesson can revisit a genuinely different weakness. Feed contrast choices to the teacher's existing strategy interface. Start with structural families already expressible in the current ABI.
items.tests: A role-swapped frame changes the expected role answer. Removing decisive evidence produces UNKNOWN or an alternative set, not a guessed singleton. Re-running a noise seed reproduces the exact variant. Three contrast families pass literal oracle checks and original-source preservation. The same old failure is not relabeled as a novel example merely by paraphrasing.

items.title: Complete the single-authority semantic cutover and release receipt
items.api: audit_atlas_authority(release, abi, ast, lesson_manifest, registry_mirror) -> AuthorityReceipt
items.steps: Trace every current semantic input to one explicit admitted source release or separately declared formal domain. Verify ABI, AST, frames, lesson manifests, graph projection and registry mirror share that binding. Classify old catalogs as historical readers or generated derivatives; remove current-path overrides and duplicate aliases once callers migrate. Extend the existing semantic-boundary guard with declared imports and ownership rules, not a regex ban on every historical filename. Produce a compact source-to-consumer table and a rebuild receipt. Close #295 only after its existing acceptance is met on the exact combined branch; this leaf's completion alone must identify any remaining existing-owner work. Keep the source-grade implementation generic and add one Grade-D-equivalent data-only successor witness.
items.tests: Regenerate release/ABI/AST/lessons twice and compare hashes. A stale shadow catalog cannot alter current semantics. Historical receipts still decode. One new released semantic reaches compiled lesson and read-only graph projection with unchanged old indices. A deliberate mismatched digest is caught at the first consumer. Record exact code head and existing-owner completion disposition.

items.title: Enforce combined context eligibility before neural or motif access
items.steps: Implement versioned ContextEligibility and EligibleContext records using the shared eligibility contract. Validate all member handles and pair/set joins before A05 packing and B08 motif reads. Produce stable reason codes for release mismatch, revoked source, temporal mismatch, forbidden join, unresolved purpose and invisible prefix. Retain blocked evidence only in the authorized source store; return source handles and bounded diagnostics to the caller. Emit a digest over the approved membership and relevant policy/time/rights projections. Runtime exact operators, neural attention and cached transforms consume only this approved view. Provide PUBLIC_FORMAL envelopes for existing source-grounded A/B/C constructors. Public tests use independent synthetic actors/scopes. Changes to eligibility generate C09 invalidations; a live external policy service is not required for each gradient step because the visit pins one approved frontier. Predecessor trace: BAV-REQ-010/F09; the implementation follows the explicit BAMF-0.2 contract repeated here.
items.tests: Two individually allowed frames with a forbidden joint scope produce ContextHold before any pooling or lookup. Revocation invalidates a formerly permitted view. Different policy/time frontiers produce different cache identities. A future constituent has no eligible handle. PUBLIC_FORMAL A/B/C fixtures remain executable without NLP or network calls. The full-set positive case produces an identical eligibility digest across input enumeration order while preserving source order inside each frame.

items.title: Declare BAMF v2 topology and generate the complete parameter manifest
items.steps: Implement explicit v1/v2 deserialization and a model factory dispatch keyed by architecture ID bamf-atlas-v2. Freeze dense geometry, modules, initializer seeds and shape policy. Declare every weight/norm/gate/head/convolution/adapter tensor centrally, with stable names, FP32 type and FAST/SLOW group. Generate initialization, shape validation, parameter count, optimizer tree and serialization order from this declaration. Preserve v1 reader behavior. Initial dense matrices count67,239,936, semantic table6,291,456 and motif table2,097,152; auxiliary tensors must be itemized and final total printed, not forced to a marketing estimate. Three rank8 adapters add36,864 matrix parameters. Frame feature and type tables use their declared separate capacities. Version embedding-bank extents as generation state, while dense geometry remains immutable. Store source/release and teacher identities separately from topology. Make config self-describing and validate contradictory channels/heads, zero sizes and unsupported dtypes before allocation. Predecessor trace: BAV-REQ-007; the implementation follows the explicit BAMF-0.2 contract repeated here.
items.tests: Exact generated shapes agree with an instantiated tree and serialized tree. Seed equality reproduces initialization. Invalid16Q/7KV, oddRoPE24-mismatch or different FFN method rejects. v1 historical metadata still reads. v2 bank extension changes extent receipt but not stable dense-topology digest. Report all tensors and exact parameters without constructing alternative model sizes.

items.title: Implement tied factorized semantic embeddings and paged readout
items.api: embed_atoms(params, ConceptBatch, AtlasFeatures) -> Tensor[B,A,768]; semantic_logits(hidden, active_banks) -> IndexedLogits
items.steps: Implement the factorized embedding equation and fixed feature shapes. Respect per-row active state both in lookup validation and readout masking. Assemble multi-bank logits in global ABI order and expose an index map so sparse active IDs remain correctly addressed. Treat learned feature gates as parameters. Use deterministic feature-composed initialization only for newly admitted identity rows, leaving established rows intact. Include structural role/schema/position vectors without conflating their IDs with semantic vocabulary. Gather constituent embeddings differentiably; exact indices/sidecar data are nondifferentiable input. Use stable masked logsumexp for loss; reject a task with no legal answers rather than emitNaNs. Record parameter-update coverage for identity, feature and gate tensors in a disposable proof. Use B01's normative Tensor ledger as the complete tensor/initializer authority. Each module owns only its named prefix; shared feature/depth/identity paths remain shared. Constructor output must match the expanded ParameterSpec list exactly.
items.tests: A changed role changes embedding while sameID identity component stays equal. Inactive row receives zero gradient and cannot be predicted. An active row in bank1 decodes to global8192+. Tied output reuses identical parameter object/name, not a copied head. Save/load reproduces logits to1e-6 FP32 on fixedCPU reference where available or declaredMLX tolerance.

items.title: Build the role-aware frame encoder and constituent handles
items.steps: Implement the exact FrameEncoder equations from B01 Tensor ledger using role-ordered members and explicit occurrence positions. Return global seeds, original member embeddings, immutable source handles and feature summaries. Preserve gradients through original members and the frame pass. Atomic fallback preserves its atom embedding; empty legal structural nodes use the specified seed. Partial frames include only visible members. Source/parent/scope handles preserve nesting. Record frame-fill/fallback counts.
items.tests: Role swap yields a changed encoding and exact sidecar. Repeated concepts with different occurrences remain separately addressable. Nested and atomic paths both reach the same outputshape. Future member changes cannot influence partial-frame encoding. One lossbackward reaches identity, role and frameinteraction weights. Empty legal structural node remains finite.

items.title: Implement causal compressed-convolution GQA and incremental RoPE caches
items.steps: Project Q/K/V with frozen shapes and apply independent per-channel three-tap convolution to projected pre-RoPE arrays. Initialize kernel[0,0,1] under oldest-to-current ordering so initial behavior is identity. Use left padding only; keep last two pre-convolution projected values perhead in decode cache. Scope/sequence boundaries zero the history, including a boundary inside a batch. Apply MLX fast.rope toQ/K with exact offset, then native fast SDPA16:8GQA. Handle allmasked/paddedquery rows by an explicit zero-result mask. Recombine384 and outputproject768. Cache manifest carries layer,scope,prefix,RoPEvariant andgeneration. Include a tiny explicit FP32 reference implementation for equality testing only; production uses fusedSDPA. Store installedMLXversion in runtime identity and use its observed signature, not undocumented flags. Predecessor trace: BAV-REQ-008; the implementation follows the explicit BAMF-0.2 contract repeated here. Use B01's normative Tensor ledger as the complete tensor/initializer authority. Each module owns only its named prefix; shared feature/depth/identity paths remain shared. Constructor output must match the expanded ParameterSpec list exactly.
items.tests: Compare fused and explicit reference on2heads-equivalent fixture within1e-5relative/1e-6absolute where supported. Full-prefix versus chunked/single-token outputs agree within tolerance. Perturb future suffix and preserve earlier output exactly within tolerance. Confirm KV storage is8heads, not16tiled. Boundary reset,allmaskedrow and two unequal lengths remain finite. One backward reachesQ/K/V/conv/outputparameters.

items.title: Implement three-group Block AttnRes with stable depth selection
items.steps: Implement the exact Q/K/V/output and per-boundary gated residual equations in the depth contract. Retain h0 and summaries at layers4,8,12; shared selector projections have128 inner channels and the residual interface stays768. The type/role composition is computed by the released factor composer and uses no target labels. Source weights are normalized across h0 and completed groups only, with a fixed source order. Capture g1 after the second motif read; apply each plastic adapter after selection. Save all four shared projection matrices and the three gate vectors/biases in B01's registry and B13's checkpoint. Optional diagnostics expose alpha without assigning fixed cognitive functions to layers. Predecessor trace: BAV-REQ-009; the implementation follows the explicit BAMF-0.2 contract repeated here. Use B01's normative Tensor ledger as the complete tensor/initializer authority. Each module owns only its named prefix; shared feature/depth/identity paths remain shared. Constructor output must match the expanded ParameterSpec list exactly.
items.tests: Source weights sum to1. Changing a future group cannot change an earlier boundary. All three boundaries remain finite. A nondegenerate loss reaches multiple source states and selector weights. Save/load preserves output. Assert that all three group boundaries execute the module, rather than merely declaring it in configuration.

items.title: Add bounded recurrent constituent refinement with input recall
items.steps: Use one shared768-wide recurrent-state module with a compressed single-head192-channel member-attention block for at most two additional local passes. Each pass receives current frame hidden state, immutable original frame seed, visible member vectors and requested-role features. Reinject the original input every pass and merge through a residual gate initialized0.01. A small three-class0/1/2 routing head can learn from measured outcomes. Initial policy uses one pass for explicit member questions, zero otherwise, and permits two for unresolved nested queries. Use the prediction-local selection and quota defined in the Causal refinement contract. During training sample0/1/2 passes from the visit seed on eligible frames so the second pass receives training. Missing routing labels mask its auxiliary loss. Main answer loss still propagates through selected passes. Reuse one backbone result; refinement does not rerun all12 layers. Declare Q/K/V projections[192,768], attention output[768,192], recurrent residual gate and its bias in the tensor registry. Exact member handles return768-wide embeddings. For a selected frame, initialize state from the global frame hidden vector; query uses state+immutable_frame_seed+requested_role768; keys/values use only legal visible members. This preserves the predecessor768-wide local-resolution interface while choosing192 inner attention channels. Predecessor trace: BAV-REQ-012/013; the implementation follows the explicit BAMF-0.2 contract repeated here. Preserve immutable global hidden states and return a separate per-query refinement view. Use B01's normative Tensor ledger as the complete tensor/initializer authority. Each module owns only its named prefix; shared feature/depth/identity paths remain shared. Constructor output must match the expanded ParameterSpec list exactly.
items.tests: Zero passes is identity. One/two passes change only selected frames. Future members remain inaccessible. Original input is re-injected every pass. Backward reaches refinement parameters and two-pass save/resume repeats. Exhausted budget records remaining needs and returns the baseline answer path. One finite disposable update reduces a literal nested-role target loss. Append high-priority future frames across the8-to9 quota boundary; earlier selection IDs, pass counts and logits at fixed p are identical. Repeat with different batch padding and future teacher-forcing targets.

items.title: Implement transactional motif-key allocation and structural fallback
items.steps: Canonicalize full typed keys. Derive structural keys by replacing permitted fillers with admitted type IDs while retaining roles, scope and relation structure. Look up exact instance first, then structural motif. Allocate missing structural keys before instance keys, ordered by observed use then key digest, at most64 new slots per candidate preparation. When full, add one16384-slot page up to65536 if the resource budget permits; otherwise retain factorized fallback and pending-key evidence. Initialize new vectors deterministically. Always compare full keys after hash lookup. Stable slots are append-only. Allocation and counters used for future allocation are copy-on-write candidate state, published only on acceptance. Preserve original release keys; accepted semantics-preserving alias maps are explicit artifacts. Predecessor trace: BAV-REQ-010; the implementation follows the explicit BAMF-0.2 contract repeated here. Use B01's normative Tensor ledger as the complete tensor/initializer authority. Each module owns only its named prefix; shared feature/depth/identity paths remain shared. Constructor output must match the expanded ParameterSpec list exactly.
items.tests: Force a hash collision between distinct full keys and return the correct value. Different fillers share a permitted structural motif; role swap changes the key. Rejection restores allocation, tensor and counters byte-for-byte. Restart reproduces pending slot IDs. Capacity exhaustion uses fallback without overwrite. Page growth preserves all old slots and moments.

items.title: Train two context-gated motif-memory reads inside the model
items.steps: Implement the two exact gated motif residual reads and the gate equation from B01 Tensor ledger. Check full-key/release/scope eligibility before batched gather. Missing keys return unchanged factorized hidden state. Save every allocated vector, projection, gate and norm; report exact/structural/miss counts and actual participating rows. The second site executes after layer4 and before capturing group1 summary.
items.tests: Both read sites influence a nondegenerate loss and receive finite gradients. Changing a qualified slot affects its applicable frames. Held or foreign-release entries are not read. Miss fallback stays finite. Save/load restores values and gates. Rejection after both sites update restores the complete parent.

items.title: Provision fast adapters and explicit multi-timescale plasticity
items.steps: Add three rank8 adapters at group boundaries. Zero B matrices make initial adapters identity. FAST includes adapters, motif parameters and newly activated semantic rows; SLOW includes established embeddings and dense parameters. A new identity row becomes established after8 accepted candidates in which it participated under the shared update-mask contract. FOUNDATION updates the full tree. ADAPTIVE offers FAST candidates, then FULL after eight accepted FAST candidates; the existing teacher can request FULL earlier for foundational remediation. This policy selects update eligibility, while the teacher still selects targets, learning rate and pedagogy. Persist mode, counters, row ages and policy version. Advance clocks by accepted updates rather than wall time. Inference always consumes both groups. Freeze group eligibility at candidate preparation. Derive the final row-update mask separately for every optimizer step from actual participation and active/admitted state, before clipping and AdamW arithmetic. B12 owns optimizer moments and update counts. Apply the exact Plasticity transition contract at the retained promotion-event boundary. Use B01's normative Tensor ledger as the complete tensor/initializer authority. Each module owns only its named prefix; shared feature/depth/identity paths remain shared. Constructor output must match the expanded ParameterSpec list exactly.
items.tests: Initial adapter output equals its input. FAST changes only eligible parameters and rows. Rejected FAST candidates do not advance clocks. Eight accepted FAST candidates schedule FULL across restart. Row establishment counts its own updates. Teacher-triggered FULL uses the same generic visit path. Test FOUNDATION promotion-with-debt transition, accepted/rejected FAST/FULL schedules, teacher early FULL reset, a new semantic row, and cold resume on either side of the transition.

items.title: Implement typed scalar, slot and structured answer heads
items.steps: Reuse current Boolean, numeric and native semantic-token answer bindings. Add released role-selection and structured frame-output modalities. Concept values use the tied semantic head. Structural control uses a separate finite head for selecting roles, ending a frame and representing unresolved output. Legal roles come from the released schema; repeated roles include occurrence indices. Cap output at64 decisions, respecting the combined input/generated1024-position budget. Predict independent roles in parallel only when the answer dependency DAG allows it; dependent decisions consume earlier committed outputs. Teacher forcing exposes earlier targets only. Preserve UNKNOWN and unresolved alternative sets where allowed. Mask losses to legal active answers and actually supplied auxiliary labels. Validate a completed typed answer before publication; invalid neural output becomes an explicit solver failure/fallback request. Implement the exact AnswerPlan/v2 state transition in the Typed decoder contract. Use B01's normative Tensor ledger as the complete tensor/initializer authority. Each module owns only its named prefix; shared feature/depth/identity paths remain shared. Constructor output must match the expanded ParameterSpec list exactly.
items.tests: Current A/B/C answer mappings remain unchanged. Four-role outputs preserve binding under role swaps. A bank1 concept can be predicted and an inactive concept cannot. Earlier output positions cannot inspect later targets. UNKNOWN differs from empty set. The64-decision ceiling returns a typed budget status. Gradients reach identity and role heads. A two-step fixture first chooses a source actor and then its event role; changing step2 gold leaves step1 logits unchanged. Inference step2 receives predicted step1, training receives only prior teacher-forced step1. Missing parent, dependency cycle, END_FRAME before a required role and64-step exhaustion are literal cases.

items.title: Assemble the real atlas-native model and architecture dispatch
items.steps: Compose factorized inputs, frame encoder, input motif read,12 CCGQA/FFN blocks, three AttnRes selectors, mid-depth motif read, three adapters, local refinement and typed readout. Derive geometry from B01 and assert exact parameter-name/shape agreement. Add one backend dispatch used by inference, gradient construction, retention and championship callers.
